target_customer: Home improvement and joinery manufacturers (windows, doors, shutters) and home service companies that field technical questions, quotes and calls
problem: Field sales reps and installers lose deals waiting for answers to technical, compatibility and pricing questions; Bravi connects product docs and ERP systems so AI can answer questions, configure products, prepare quotes and answer calls.
business_model: B2B SaaS for manufacturers and installers, pricing not found
product_category: AI operating system, assistant and receptionist for manufacturers and home services

previous_startups: Snipfeed (co-founded 2017 per YC page; raised nearly 7M dollars; link-in-bio tool sold to Planoly in April 2024 per deal summary)
Volet Dumont (online shutter business used to test Bravi)

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating LLM assistants with ERP systems, complex catalogues and telephony for quotes is standard engineering with hard parts around data connectors and accuracy.

defensibility.rationale: ERP and catalogue integrations create some lock-in, but AI sales assistants are copyable and established configurator vendors target the same buyers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Configurator vendors and CRM platforms offered AI sales agents to manufacturers per 2026 vendor content; no takeover of Bravi recorded.

market_need_then: Window and door makers have complex catalogues and little modern software; the founders tested the product on their own shutter business and report about 20 manufacturer clients mainly in France (Dealroom, Runtimewire).

identity.logo: Bravi lockup logo in white and dark variants
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and practical, speed-focused headlines such as 'Just ask Bravi'.

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly short name with a clear tagline, but no external brand coverage and several unrelated Bravi entities exist.

outcome_analysis: Bravi was founded in January 2025 in Cholet, France by repeat founders from Snipfeed, entered YC in Fall 2025 and reported about 20 manufacturer clients. Two outlets report a 1.8 million dollar round in September 2026 with YC and funds. It is early with limited traction data, so the main risk is competition from configurator and CRM vendors adding AI agents.
